title.es: Aquel del viaje a Madrid con Fina
title.en: The One With the Trip to Madrid With Fina

description.es: Marta quiere seguir negociando con Patricia, pero Jesús se opone. Marta le dice a Fina que vayan a Madrid esa noche.
description.en: Marta wants to continue negotiating with Patricia, but Jesús is against it. Marta tells Fina that they should go to Madrid that evening.
